title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor takes police to court over search warrants
summary_full: Britain's former prince lodged a judicial review over the legality of search warrants in his arrest on suspicion of misconduct in public office in a case related to his Jeffrey Epstein ties. He has denied wrongdoing.
